decisions.reason: The low anchor penalizes any generic past-tense narration, so what a judge actually counts is presence of formal marking (verse, lists, odd punctuation, person/tense), a stylistic habit.

Refusal to editorialize, coherent-and-wrong narrators, unresolved endings are real editorial virtues; anchors are concrete and shock content explicitly excluded. Negative sign reflects community preference for cathartic resolution.
